## 2026-11-12 · agent/fix-offline-submit — worksheet submit without network fails clearly and keeps the answers (Fable review U4 + U5) · crm-v2 only, no rules / functions / data change

- Base: `origin/main` b8861b8, checked 2026-11-12. Branch `agent/fix-offline-submit`, draft PR.
- Cause (U4): `updateDoc` without network neither resolves nor rejects (no persistence in `client.js`), so „Esita tööleht” spun forever and the answers were only in memory. Cause (U5): autosave wrote `status: 'in_progress'` blindly, so an old tab could undo a submit.
- Fix: new `services/firebase/offlineWrite.js` (`withWriteTimeout` 8 s, `OfflineWriteError` with `pending`, Firebase `unavailable` → same message). `homework.js` `saveWorksheetDraft` / `submitWorksheet` now run in a transaction: a draft never overwrites `done` (returns `skipped`), a submit on a `done` sheet writes nothing and returns `alreadyDone` (no double submit); transactions are never queued offline. Linked homework task still marked „Tehtud”, also when the write lands late.
- Players: `DocWorksheetPlayer.jsx` and the v1 `LegacyWorksheetPlayer` (`homework/WorksheetPlayer.jsx`, used by Ülesanded, self-study and the live room) — answers copied to `localStorage` on every change (new `worksheet-studio/localAnswers.js`, try/catch; newer copy restored on open, cleared on submit); `navigator.onLine === false` fails at once; message „Võrku pole – tööleht jäi esitamata. Vastused on selles seadmes alles. Proovi uuesti, kui võrk tuleb.”; a late write finishes the sheet once; the subscription switches a sheet submitted elsewhere to „Esitatud” and stops autosave.
- Checks: new `worksheet-studio/offlineSubmit.test.jsx` (9) + 4 new / 1 updated in `services/firebase/homework.test.js`; `npx vitest run src/features/homework src/features/worksheet-studio src/features/worksheet-generator src/services/firebase/homework.test.js` → 180 files, 1978 passed, 12 skipped; full `npx vitest run` → 602 files, 4711 passed, 12 skipped; `e2e` layout suite (`npx playwright test -c playwright.layout.config.cjs`) → 31/31 incl. „a failed save says so and tries again”; eslint on changed files clean. Not tried on a real phone or against the emulator.
- Limits / risks: autosave now costs one read + one write per save (transaction); a transaction fights for the doc with the teacher's live transactions (retries, fine). Old answers typed after a failed submit are lost if the first (late) write lands first — the sheet then shows what was submitted. Rules unchanged: a stale client of the previous build can still downgrade until hosting is released.
- Next safe step: owner merges and releases hosting; on a phone in airplane mode, open a sheet → answer → „Esita tööleht” → message in ≤ 8 s → network on → „Esita” again → „Esitatud”.
## 2026-11-12 · agent/fix-credited-invoices — credited invoices don't block the month or accept payments (Fable review Д4/Д6) · ⚠ functions need deploy

- Base: `origin/main` b8861b8, checked 2026-11-12. Branch `agent/fix-credited-invoices`, draft PR. Source: `docs/review/FABLE_SYSTEM_REVIEW_2026-11-11.md` §2.2 Д4, Д6.
- Rule (one helper each side): an invoice is **fully credited** when `status === 'Krediteeritud'` or `correctionStatus` is `fully_credited` / `corrected` (`functions/finance-core.js` `invoiceIsFullyCredited`, `invoiceIsVoidOrCredited`; client `monthlyBilling.js` `invoiceBillsNothing`). It bills nothing, like `Tühistatud`. **Partial credit** (`correctionStatus: 'partially_credited'`, lesson lines credited one by one) is unchanged: still an open invoice with money due, blocks its month, takes payments, gets reminders.
- Д4: `createMonthlyInvoice` / combined monthly (`manual-invoice-api.js`, `combined-invoice-core.js billsCardForMonth`) and the client month table / lesson balance (`monthlyBilling.js invoiceForCard`) skip fully credited invoices → a new revision `-rN` can be made. A corrected invoice's replacement copies `planMonth`, so it stays the month's invoice (no duplicate); the balance now counts the replacement (before, the credited original could be found first and nothing counted).
- Д6: `recordInvoicePayment` (manual, cash allocation, LinkPay settle → `needs_review`), bank-transaction allocation and payer-credit application refuse a fully credited invoice (409, names the replacement `correctedBy.invoiceNum`); `invoiceFinancialPatch` keeps `Krediteeritud` whatever happens to payments (never back to `Ootel`); reminders (`shouldSendDue10Reminder` / `shouldSendOverdueReminder`) skip credited invoices, also old ones already back in `Ootel`; LinkPay start refuses (`linkpay-core unpayableReason`). Bank statement matching (`bank-statement-core matchLine`): a credited invoice named in the explanation → its live replacement as a „likely” suggestion; no replacement → unmatched („vali arve käsitsi”), never an automatic advance; credited invoices are never name / amount candidates.
- Not changed: FIE separation, cash out of the books (`cash-core invoicesCoveringLesson` still lists credited invoices in its informational `invoicedBefore`), accounting entries, existing data (no migration; old credited invoices in `Ootel` heal when their overpayment is resolved).
- Checks: `cd functions && npm test` → 655/655 pass (new: `credited-invoice-guards.test.js` 3, tests in `finance-core`, `bank-statement-core`, `linkpay-core`, `combined-invoice-core`, `manual-invoice-api`). `cd crm-v2 && npx vitest run src/features/finance` → 47 files, 324 tests pass (3 new in `monthlyBilling.test.js`; 2 of them fail on the old code). Emulator suite not run locally (JDK 8); CI runs it.
- **⚠ Deploy (owner):** `firebase deploy --only functions:financeApi,functions:invoiceApi,functions:linkpayApi,functions:manualInvoiceApi,functions:sendInvoicePaymentReminders`, then hosting release (client month table); log in `docs/DEPLOY_LEDGER.md`.
- Risk: re-issuing a credited month after the next month's invoice was made can charge the same lessons twice (the next month's correction already counted them) — same as for a cancelled month today; admin checks the correction. Next safe step: owner reviews and merges, deploys functions, then credits one test invoice in full and sees the month row „Valmis” again.

## 2026-11-11 · agent/release-gate — release waits for green CI; one CRM v2 workflow; pet game timers; deploy ledger · CI + docs, no deploy

- Base: `origin/main` 6719bcf, checked 2026-11-10. Branch `agent/release-gate`, draft PR. From the independent review 2026-11-11 (I1, I2). - Release gate (`.github/workflows/release.yml` + new `.github/scripts/release-ci-gate.sh`): after „did the app change”, the job takes the newest first-parent commit on main that touched the CRM v2 paths and the newest push run of `crm-v2.yml` on main that contains it (and is part of the released HEAD). Green → release commit as before; red / cancelled → step fails with `::error` + summary and a link to the run, nothing pushed; running or no run yet → polls every 30 s up to 25 min, then fails („not releasing unchecked code”). Job timeout 5 → 35 min, `actions: read`. The push is still a plain fast-forward of the checked HEAD. Not gated: a merge whose own message has `[deploy]` / `[hotfix]` — Vercel builds it at once (`vercel-ignore.sh`); documented in release.yml and AGENTS.md (safe hotfix = merge, then run Release). Financial Core / Security workflows are not part of the gate (they do not ship with Vercel).

Concurrency: PR runs cancel older runs of the same PR; on main every commit keeps its own run (group by sha) — the old per-ref group cancelled most main runs. Branch protection / rulesets: none on main (`gh api …/branches/main/protection` → 404, rulesets `[]`), so no required check names depended on „CRM v2 CI”. `docs/WORKSHEET_PHONE_VIEW.md` points to the new job.

## 2026-11-10 · agent/forms-lookup-parallel — EKI word forms: candidates side by side, time limits, „no forms” cache · ⚠ functions:languageApi needs deploy

- Base: `origin/main` 9685e6f (includes #1195), checked 2026-11-10. Branch `agent/forms-lookup-parallel`, draft PR. Follow-up of agent/word-popover-speed: forms for a new word („kaua”) took several seconds because `estonianWordForms` tried the headword candidates (kaua → kaua, kau, ka) one after another, each an Ekilex search + paradigm with 8 s timeouts.
- Done (`functions/index.js` `estonianWordForms`, used by `/forms`, `/word`, `/key-forms`, `/student-word`, `/own-word`): candidates run side by side (`FORMS_TIMING.concurrency` 4) through `firstInOrder` — the first candidate **in the old order** whose paradigm contains the clicked form still wins; once decided, later candidates are not started and running requests are aborted. Each Ekilex request ≤ 4.5 s (`requestMs`, via the `languageBudget` store, `fetchJsonWithin` now also honours `requestMs` and `signal`), the whole lookup ≤ 7 s (`totalMs`, or the caller's shorter budget). At most 8 Ekilex requests at once per instance (`createLimiter`, queued tasks keep their caller's async context). Cache: same key `languageCache/forms2_…`; found forms kept forever as before; „no forms” now kept 30 days (`expiresAt`); a lookup that failed / ran out of its own time is remembered 10 min (`failed: true`) so a repeated click answers 504 at once; a found answer behind a failed earlier candidate is shown but not kept and counts in the caller's `trace.failed` (own-word does not cache it). Old entries without `expiresAt` stay valid.
- Not done: a Vabamorf fast path. The repo's Vabamorf data (`crm-v2/public/word-forms.json` lemma → 3 forms, generator `lexicon/forms.json`) lives in crm-v2, maps lemmas, not clicked forms → lemma, and is not in the functions bundle; with parallel candidates the time is already ~one search + one paradigm round trip.
- Files: `functions/index.js`, `functions/language-core.js` (`firstInOrder`, `createLimiter`, `cacheEntryFresh`), new `functions/forms-lookup.test.js`, `functions/language-api.test.js` (URL order assertion). No rules, memory, region, minInstances or client change.
- Checks: `cd functions && npm test` → 618/618 passed (new file: 18 tests — order priority with a slow earlier hit, concurrency cap, early stop, failures, limiter ≤ 8 across 5 words, request/total deadline 504, caller budget not cached as failure, negative cache 30 days and expiry, 10-min failure memory, trace propagation). eslint (recommended rules, temp config, functions has none) on changed files: no new problems (index.js has 21 old ones elsewhere). Mocked timings (scratch script, concurrency 1 = old loop vs 4): 300 ms per Ekilex request — kaua 1509 → 602 ms, koolis 1506 → 603 ms, raamatukogus 1204 → 602 ms; 800 ms per request — 4006 → 1603, 4006 → 1602, 3205 → 1602 ms; repeat click 0–1 ms (cache). Real EKI not measured: no EKILEX_API_KEY on this machine (Ekilex answers 403 without it).
- Limits: up to ~4 extra Ekilex requests per new word (candidates that the old loop would have skipped after an earlier hit); a 504 for a word is repeated for 10 min even if EKI recovers sooner. The 1 GB cold start of `languageApi` is unchanged.
- ⚠ Needs deploy: `firebase deploy --only functions:languageApi` (from fresh main after merge).
- Next safe step: owner reviews and merges the PR, then deploy `functions:languageApi` and double-click a new word in a live lesson.

## 2026-11-09 · agent/word-audio — real Estonian audio (Neurokõne) for every course word, example and listening sentence · ⚠ storage.rules need deploy

- Base: `origin/main` 9121782, checked 2026-11-09 (merged in). Branch `agent/word-audio`, draft PR #1177. Owner decision 2026-11-09: TartuNLP Neurokõne (free public API, voice „mari”), generated once and stored by us; owner approved the TTS calls and the production Storage upload. Contract: `docs/VOCABULARY_SRS.md` „Sõnade heli”.
- Done: generator `crm-v2/scripts/word-audio/build-word-audio.mjs` (+ pure `lib.mjs`): texts = 5047 lesson words + 5047 example sentences (`vocabulary/lessonWords/*.json`) + 816 listening sentences (build items ≤ 10 tiles, A2/B1/B2/C1) → **8882 unique**; key = 12 hex of `sha1("mari|" + normalised text)` (`vocabulary/wordAudioKey.js`, shared with the app); 2 parallel, ≤ ~3 req/s, backoff on 408/429/5xx, resumable (cache `~/.cache/keelesepp-word-audio/` + Storage listing), `--limit`, `--dry-run`, `--no-upload`; silence trim + two-pass loudnorm −18 LUFS → **AAC-LC .m4a 48 kb/s mono** (plays on iOS Safari, Chrome, Firefox). App: `vocabulary/wordAudio.js` (lazy `/word-audio.json`, play order stored file → lesson `audio` → browser et-EE voice, failure falls through, preload); flashcards play the stored file without a browser voice, example sentence has its own button, current + next 2 cards preloaded; practice „Kuula ja pane kokku” whenever the sentence has a file (`buildLesson` `canListen` may be a per-item function), „Aeglaselt” = 0.75×; credit „Hääl: Neurokõne (TartuNLP)” at the bottom of „Sõnad”.
- Production: Storage `gs://keelesepp-5136b.firebasestorage.app/audio/words/<key>.m4a` — **8882 files, 109.1 MB**, `audio/mp4`, `Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable`. Run: pilot 30 (68 s, words 0.7–1.2 s / 5–9 KB, sentences 1.4–1.9 s / 10–13 KB, mean −19 dB), then full 5530 s (8852 synthesized, 4.5 h of speech, 6 TTS retries, 0 TTS failures; 1 upload ECONNRESET, uploaded by the resume run). `crm-v2/public/word-audio.json` 8882 keys, 133 KB (66 KB gzip).
- `storage.rules`: new `match /audio/words/{fileName}` — `allow get` if name `^[0-9a-f]{12}[.]m4a$`, `allow write: if false`. **Deploy needed (owner): `firebase deploy --only storage`.** Until then the files answer 403 (checked) and the app falls back to lesson audio / browser voice — but a listening item on a device without an Estonian voice would be silent, so deploy the rules **before or with** hosting.
- Checks: full `npx vitest run` after merging main 579 files passed (1 skipped), 4480 tests; new `vocabulary/wordAudio.test.js` (sha1 = Node crypto, normalisation, manifest lookup, fallback order, preload, per-item canListen), `scripts/word-audio/lib.test.js` (collection, dedupe, resume plan, limit, backoff, silence bounds, loudnorm parse, manifest), FlashcardSession stored-file test; eslint on changed files clean. Not checked in a real browser / phone (needs the rules deploy); not listened to by a human.
- Limits: one voice; students' own non-course words have no file; edited/new course texts need a new generator run (+ commit the manifest); old files stay in Storage when a text changes.
- Next safe step: owner deploys `storage.rules`, opens „Sõnad” → a lesson deck on an iPhone and taps the sound button and the example's button.

## 2026-11-09 · agent/bookmark-anchor — board „Järjehoidja” attached to a word or sentence of the worksheet (Live Classroom) · ⚠ firestore.rules changed, need deploy

- Anchor (`features/board/bookmarkAnchor.js`): `{ kind: word|sentence|phrase, quote, before, after (≤ 40 chars each), sentence (≤ 600), blockId (worksheet `[data-block]`, '' = page), start, end }`. Text of a block = its text nodes joined (teacher marks layer, popup and the hidden `.ws-measure` copy skipped); paragraph / chip boundaries (computed display not inline) are word and sentence breaks. Found again by offsets, else by the quote with the best matching context (then nearest), else in the whole page. Sentences: `. ! ? …` + closing quotes, next starts with a capital / number / „; not after abbreviations (nt., hr., lk., vrd. …), initials, ordinals („1. septembril”).

- Shown: the quote highlighted in a stronger shade of the paper colour + a small marker after it (SVG layer, follows the sheet: MutationObserver + ResizeObserver); clicking the marker opens the note (read only for what one may not change, e.g. the teacher's for a student); the eraser on it removes it from the board (the note stays, as before). Dialog shows „Sõna: „…” — sentence” / „Lause: „…””. Anchored bookmarks are not dragged (`movable` false) and not grabbed by `textAt`.

- Bugs: (a) the „õ ä ö ü” bar (and the folded „õ”) is placed beside the whole bookmark dialog (`data-letters-box`, `letters.js` `letterBox`) — no longer over the paper colour dots; (b) opening the bookmark sheet closes the sheet's „Märkus / Analüüs” popup and opening that popup closes the bookmark sheet.
- Data / rules: board `note` element and `studentNotes` doc may carry `anchor` (new `bookmarkAnchorValid`; on the board only with `bookmark: true`; note `anchor` only at create, never updated). Emulator: `student-notes` + `whiteboard-rules` 15/15 passed (new cases). Deploy needed (owner's approval): `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` + hosting; without the rules an anchored bookmark fails with „permission denied” (free bookmarks keep working).
- Files: `crm-v2/src/features/board/{bookmarkAnchor.js,bookmarkContext.js,bookmarkModel.js,BookmarkDialog.jsx,StudentBoard.jsx,LetterBar.jsx,letters.js,boardModel.js,board.css,bookmarkAnchor.test.js,bookmarkAnchor.ui.test.jsx}`, `crm-v2/src/features/worksheet-studio/SheetAnnotations.jsx`, `crm-v2/src/features/self-study/{MistakesPage.jsx,MistakesPage.test.jsx,selfStudy.css}`, `firestore.rules`, `functions/{student-notes,whiteboard-rules}-emulator.integration.js`.

New tests: `storageClient.test.js`, `re2jsStub.test.js`, `shellPrefetch.test.js`; `routes.home.test.jsx` waits longer for the lazy shell. `vite preview` with a fake Firebase config: /login renders, no console messages, only react + firebase + main + CSS before paint, shell fetched after load; `/` starts the shell at once. No sign-in anywhere.
- Limits / risks: the shell is now ~50 small files (shared icons/models) fetched in parallel; if the shell file fails to download the shell area shows the page error („Lehte ei saanud avada” / reload) instead of a blank screen; a future Firestore Pipelines regex/LIKE query would return an error value until the alias is removed. Firestore (~95 KB gzip) is still on /login (auth.js / clientErrors import it).

## 2026-11-09 · agent/batched-release — the CRM is released in batches, not on every merge (Vercel cost)

- Base: `origin/main`, checked 2026-11-09. Branch `agent/batched-release`.
- Why: the Vercel bill went over the Pro credit. On 2026-11-05 build CPU was 4.6K minutes ($16.11) and deployment storage 1.43 TB ($4.77). There were ~730 production builds in a month, one per merge to main, and each uploaded a 365 MB dist (audio 276 MB).
- Done:
  - `crm-v2/scripts/vercel-ignore.sh` is the CRM project's `ignoreCommand` (`crm-v2/vercel.json`). `main` builds only when the commit message contains `[deploy]` or `[hotfix]`; agent/* previews stay skipped; other branches build as before.
  - New `.github/workflows/release.yml` runs at 05:00 and 14:00 UTC and on „Run workflow”. If `crm-v2/` changed since the last `[deploy]`/`[hotfix]` commit, it pushes an empty `[deploy] Release …` commit to main, which Vercel builds.
  - AGENTS.md documents the rule.
  - The public website project (root `vercel.json`) is unchanged. Its upload is the small static site only, and `.vercelignore` would hide the script from it.
- Hotfix: put `[hotfix]` in the PR title (the merge commit message carries it).
- Checks: ran the ignore script by hand for main / main + `[hotfix]` / `[deploy]` / agent/x / another branch → 0 / 1 / 1 / 0 / 1. `hostingHeaders.test.js` passed. The workflow runs for the first time after merge.
- Risk: a merge without `[deploy]` waits up to ~9 hours, or until someone presses „Run workflow”.
- Next safe step: after the first scheduled run, check that Vercel built the release commit, and in the next weekly usage mail that build minutes dropped.

## 2026-11-09 · agent/translate-guard — the browser's page translation no longer crashes a lesson (owner 2026-11-09)

- Base: `origin/main` d5d3681, checked 2026-11-09. Branch `agent/translate-guard`.
- Owner: students and teachers sometimes lose the lesson when they press translate. clientErrors confirmed it: `Failed to execute 'removeChild' on 'Node'` on /student and /homework, and Safari's `The object can not be found here` on /. That is Chrome/Safari page translation replacing React's text nodes (facebook/react#11538).
- Done: `src/app/translateGuard.js` (installed first in `main.jsx`). It turns removeChild of a node that already left its parent into a no-op and turns insertBefore with such a reference into an append. Translation stays allowed, because learners translate Estonian screens into Russian. Test `translateGuard.test.jsx` translates a rendered tree and re-renders; without the guard the same test throws.
- Checks: `npx vitest run src/app src/features/students src/features/homework src/features/live-classroom` → 104 files, 591 tests passed.
- Not done: live-room `presence` permission errors (5 in clientErrors) are a separate fix.
- Next safe step: watch admin „Vead” for a week; removeChild / „can not be found here” should stop.

## 2026-11-06 · agent/per-subject-billing — billing mode, lessons per week and no-show rule per subject (finance)

- Base: `origin/main` d3ed25d (#1123), checked 2026-11-06. Branch `agent/per-subject-billing`, draft PR (finance). Open PRs at start: #1062 (site address) only, not touched. No production reads/writes, no deploy, no data migration.
- Owner 2026-11-06: „Arveldus” and „Tunde nädalas” must be set per subject on the student card's „Tunnitasu” tabs. Done for billing mode, lessons per week and the no-show charge (used per invoice line / per lesson credit). Price terms, discount reason and „Kehtib alates” stay card-wide (only the card's price history uses `validFrom`).
- Model: optional `studentRevenuePlans.subjectBilling = { "<subject>": { billingMode?, weeklyLessons?, chargeNoShow? } }` (a separate map, so every price reader of `subjectPrices` is untouched). Absent field → the card's value; the main subject is always the card's values. No existing plan has the field, so all of them bill exactly as before. `firestore.rules`: field allowed, must be a map of ≤ 8 (finance role cannot write it).
- One resolver, two equal copies: `functions/subject-billing-core.js` + `crm-v2/src/features/finance/subjectBilling.js` (the functions test imports the browser file and compares results). Readers: monthly rows (`monthlyBilling.js`: a package subject gets no line, the row shows „tunnipaketiga: …”; no-show rule per subject in the correction; lessons left per subject), `studentLessonBalances` (student card, Täna „Makstud tunnid lõppevad”), forecasts (`finance.js revenueForecast`, server `financial-analytics-core`: card price × card weekly + further subjects with their own weekly × their price), `financeDashboard.noShowCharged` (Ülevaade / Ärinäitajad), server monthly routes (`combined-invoice-core monthlyBillingBlocker`: 400 for a package subject or actual-next-to-advance, only for plans with `subjectBilling`), lesson-package trigger (`index.js syncLessonPackageConsumption`: with `subjectBilling` the lesson's subject decides the no-show rule and a monthly subject takes no credit, also not from an old shared package), card merge (`student-card-merge-core revenuePlanMerge` carries the other card's differing billing into `subjectBilling[its subject]`). `mainSubject` moved to `functions/student-enrollments-core.js` (merge core reuses it).
- Rule: „Pärast toimunud tunde” cannot be combined on one card with „Kuu ette” / „Jooksev kuu” (one monthly invoice; different months). The card form refuses it with the reason, the Kuuarved row shows „Arveldusviisid ei sobi”, the server refuses it. Packages combine with any mode.
- UI (`students/BillingSettingsCard.jsx`): the main subject's tab has „Arveldus”, „Tunde nädalas” and the no-show checkbox (the card's values) with „?” help (`BILLING_MODE_HELP`, `WEEKLY_LESSONS_HELP`, `NO_SHOW_HELP` in `revenuePlans.js`); a further subject shows „Sama mis kaardil: …” per field with „Määra sellele ainele” and, when own, the field plus „Sama mis kaardil”. Tab labels show the mode. „Ühine kõigile ainetele” keeps only „Kehtib alates”. `subjectBilling` is sent only when a subject has / had its own values (`revenuePlans.save` writes it only then), so saving a card without overrides works before the rules deploy.
- Example: card Eesti keel 20 €/60 min „Kuu ette”, Inglise keel 25 € „Tunnipakett”, Matemaatika 28 €/45 min with free no-shows. November invoice: „Eesti keel: Keeletunnid, november 2031: 4 × 60 min × 20,00 €” + „Matemaatika: Tunnid …: 4 × 45 min × 28,00 €” (+ maths correction −1 for an October no-show); no English line — English lessons take package credits. Before: English would have had a monthly line too.
- Files: `functions/{subject-billing-core.js,subject-billing-core.test.js,combined-invoice-core.js,combined-invoice-core.test.js,manual-invoice-api.js,index.js,financial-analytics-core.js,financial-analytics-core.test.js,student-card-merge-core.js,student-card-merge-core.test.js,student-enrollments-core.js,finance-emulator.integration.js}`, `firestore.rules`, `crm-v2/src/features/finance/{subjectBilling.js,monthlyBilling.js,legacyBillingFixtures.js,monthlyBilling.golden.json,monthlyBilling.golden.test.js,monthlyBilling.subjectBilling.test.js,MonthlyInvoicePanel.jsx,MonthlyInvoicePanel.test.jsx,finance.js,finance.test.js,financeDashboard.js,financeDashboard.test.js,businessReport.js}`, `crm-v2/src/features/students/{BillingSettingsCard.jsx,BillingSettingsCard.test.jsx,studentFinancePanel.css}`, `crm-v2/src/services/firebase/{revenuePlans.js,revenuePlans.test.js}`, `crm-v2/src/features/dashboard/today/todayModel.test.js`, `ARCHITECTURE.md` („Billing per subject”), `docs/LESSON_TOKENS.md`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`.

Not checked in a browser against real data (needs admin sign-in).

## 2026-11-05 · agent/fix-live-room-errors — live room: „reading 'default'” crash and presence permission errors

- Base: `origin/main` a743ce2 (#1114 merged), checked 2026-11-05. Client code + tests + docs; firestore.rules unchanged; no production calls or writes, no deploy.
- A) clientErrors „TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'default')” (Chrome, admin, /live-classroom/vaatle/:id) and „undefined is not an object (evaluating 'g._result.default')” (Safari, teacher, /live-classroom). Every `lazy(() => import(...))` target already had a default export — not the cause. Real cause: `main.jsx` handles Vite's `vite:preloadError` (file of an older build gone after a deploy) with `reloadOnceForNewBuild()` + `event.preventDefault()`; with preventDefault Vite 7 resolves the import with `undefined`, so React.lazy crashed on `undefined.default` before the reload landed (#1102 made the room parts lazy, so a deploy during a lesson hits it).
- Fix A: new `crm-v2/src/app/lazyComponent.js` (`lazyComponent(loader)`, `guardLazyModule`): an `undefined` module waits for the reload (loading state stays) and after 10 s fails as a stale-build error; a module without default throws a clear error. All 87 `lazy(` uses (routes, HomePage, AppShell, LiveClassroomPage, LiveRoom, RoomWorksheetPanel, StudentBoard, Sheet, WorksheetStudioPage, StudentProfilePage, MaterialPreview, CourseProductionPage) now use it. New `crm-v2/src/features/live-classroom/RoomPartBoundary.jsx`: a failing room part shows „… ei saanud avada.” / „KeeleSepp uuenes tunni ajal.” + „Laadi uuesti” in its place (stale build → page reload; other error → retry in place, reported as `render`); wraps the room view in LiveClassroomPage, every LiveRoom drawer, LessonHints, RoomRecorder, the room worksheet and RoomStepControl.
- B) clientErrors „Missing or insufficient permissions (set liveLessonInvitations/{id}/presence/{id})” (admin + teacher, /live-classroom and /calendar). The only writer is `useLiveCall` (heartbeat every 20 s + `markOffline` on unmount); the observer („vaatle”) writes `observers/`, not `presence/`. The rule allows presence only for the invitation's own teacher/student while status is `accepted`. Cause: „Lõpeta tund” closes the invitation → the room unmounts (teacher then lands on /calendar) → `markOffline` writes into a closed room → refused and reported (the student side the same when the close arrives; a heartbeat between close and unmount too). Rule is correct, unchanged.
- Fix B: `useLiveCall` keeps the latest invitation status; no heartbeat / offline mark unless `accepted`; a permission-denied heartbeat stops further heartbeats without the error banner (other errors still shown). `liveLessonPresenceService.markOffline` reads the invitation first (pending local writes included) and skips the write unless `accepted` (one read per room exit).
- Tests added: `crm-v2/src/app/lazyComponent.test.jsx` (no bare React `lazy` anywhere; every lazily loaded file has `export default`; every live-classroom / worksheet-studio / board lazy part + `loadLiveRoom` really imports with a `.default`; undefined import keeps the loading state; RoomPartBoundary behaviour), `crm-v2/src/features/live-classroom/useLiveCall.presence.test.jsx`, `crm-v2/src/services/firebase/liveLessonPresence.test.js`, emulator case in `functions/live-lesson-invitations-emulator.integration.js` (teacher/student online+offline OK; admin observer own or teacher's presence 403; closed invitation offline mark 403 for both, invitation still readable).
- Checks: `cd crm-v2 && npx eslint src --quiet` no output; `npx vitest run src/features/live-classroom src/features/board src/features/worksheet-studio src/features/calendar src/app src/services/firebase src/components` 213 files, 1484/1484 passed; full `npx vitest run` 4095 passed, 1 failed = `WorksheetStudioPage.test.jsx` 20 s timeout under load (24/24 pass alone); `functions/live-lesson-invitations-emulator.integration.js` on the auth+firestore emulators (demo project, JDK 21) 10/10 passed.
- Deploy: hosting only (client); no rules or functions deploy needed. Owner's OK required.
- Next safe step: after the hosting deploy, watch „Vead” for 1–2 lesson days: both reports should stop; a remaining `presence` refusal would point at a status other than closed (e.g. cancelled while in the room).

- Base: `origin/main` d801ce0 (#1113 merged), checked 2026-11-05; open PRs #1114 (word-tap regression test) and #1062 not touched. Functions `languageApi /own-word` + board / vocabulary UI; no rules, no other endpoints' behaviour, no content; no production writes, no deploy.
- Why: production log of `languageApi` 2026-11-05 — every `/own-word` 9–13 s (spelling chain etLex → Ekilex → forms, then the translation, one after another, each call up to 8 s); 15:22 UTC in a live lesson both upstreams timed out after ~20 s and the student's word card had no translation.
- Server (`functions/index.js`): `checkOwnWord` runs the spelling chain and the TartuNLP translation of the typed text side by side; the base form (from etLex, then Ekilex) is translated as soon as it is known if ≥ 0.7 s remain. `OWN_WORD_TIMING = { upstreamMs: 4500, totalMs: 5000, lemmaMinMs: 700, cacheDays: 90 }`: each upstream call stops at 4.5 s (`fetchJsonWithin` reads the deadline from an `AsyncLocalStorage` `languageBudget`; other endpoints keep 8 s), the answer leaves by 5 s with what arrived. New answer fields `partial: boolean`, `missing: ['spelling'|'forms'|'translation']`; translation prefers the base form's, else the typed form's (`translationOf` says which). Whole-answer cache `languageCache/ownword1_<sha(lang, tgt, lowercased text)>` = `{ value, createdAt, expiresAt (+90 d) }`, admin SDK only, written only when nothing failed or came late; read in parallel with the quota (quota unchanged: still counted on a hit). The per-upstream entries of `languageCache` stay as they were.
- Client: `services/firebase/languageTools.js` `/own-word` aborts after 8 s („Keeletööriist ei vastanud õigel ajal.”); `vocabulary/ownWord.js` `parseCheck` keeps `partial` / `missing`, `partialText`; `OwnWordForm.jsx` shows „Puudu: tõlge … — teenus vastas aeglaselt” + „Proovi uuesti” (also after an error). Board: `wordTap.js` (`lookupWord` passes partial / missing; the session memo drops partial answers too), `BoardLanguageTools.jsx` (`lookup` / `retry`), `WordTapCard.jsx` („Otsin…” at once, „Põhivormi ei jõudnud leida.”, „Proovi uuesti”), `languageTools.css` (`.sb-word-tap__retry`).
- Tests: new `functions/own-word-speed.test.js` (9: cache miss → kept 90 d, hit < 300 ms with no upstream call, expired entry ignored, translation starts before etLex answers, both slow → answer at the budget, partial, nothing kept, translation down, spelling slow, Ekilex error not kept, English kept); board tests (partial + retry, timeout + retry), `wordTap.test.js` (partial memo), `OwnWordForm.test.jsx` (partial + retry).
- Checks: `cd functions && npm test` 522/522 passed; `cd crm-v2 && npm run lint` 0 errors (22 old warnings, none in changed files); `npx vitest run src/features/board src/features/vocabulary` 28 files, 233/233 passed (VocabularyPage once timed out under load, passes alone). Not run against the real EKI / TartuNLP services (no paid or external calls in tests).
- Deploy needs (after the owner's OK): `firebase deploy --only functions:languageApi` + hosting. Firestore rules unchanged (`languageCache` has no client rule = server only). Optional: a Firestore TTL policy on `languageCache.expiresAt` (only cleanup; expired entries are ignored anyway).
- Limits: a cold start of `languageApi` is outside the 5 s budget (the client waits 8 s). An answer with a failed sub-call is not cached, so a word whose Ekilex lookup always fails is asked every time. Late upstream calls go on unobserved after the answer (their own sub-caches may still fill).
- PR: draft (see GitHub, `agent/fast-word-lookup`). Production: none.
- Next safe step: after the owner's OK deploy `functions:languageApi` and hosting, then read the `own-word answered` log lines (ms / missing / kept) during the next lesson.

## 2026-11-05 · agent/fix-writing-block-input — live lesson: answer fields could not be typed into after a board press

- Base: `origin/main` 290decd (#1110 merged), checked 2026-11-05. Board / Live Classroom only; no rules, data, functions or content changed; no production writes, no deploy.
- Report (owner, 1:1 lesson 2026-11-05): the student could not type into task 6 „Kodutöö: Kirjuta arvamus (100–120 sõna)” (block `writing`, ruled lines, „Lauseid: 0 / 6–12”) under the teacher's yellow spotlight, default tool „Täida töölehte” on; the day before typing worked.
- Checked and ruled out (Chromium, `sheet-lab` incl. new `?live=1` full student room, desktop + iPad emulation, Firestore-like echo of every autosave): the field is interactive (not review / readOnly), nothing covers it (`elementsFromPoint` = the textarea), focus and typing work with the spotlight, the letter bar, answer fonts, word tap, tab bar, poll / pet / video windows, hints, correction marks.
- Root cause (most likely; WebKit-only, so not reproducible in Chromium): #1071 „no text selection while drawing” (`StudentBoard.blockSelection`) puts `sb-drawing` on `<html>` (`-webkit-user-select: none` on html/body) and cancels every `selectstart` on the document from a board pointerdown (Vali / Liiguta / pen / shapes / eraser) and removed both ONLY in the drawing layer's own pointerup. A release it never sees (off the board, over the dock or a floating video window, Safari losing the SVG pointer capture, the window losing focus) left both on for the rest of the lesson. Safari inherits `-webkit-user-select` into fields and a field with `none` takes no typing — every answer field on the sheet stops working while Chrome keeps working.
- Fix: `crm-v2/src/features/board/StudentBoard.jsx` — the block also ends on any window pointerup / pointercancel / mouseup / touchend / touchcancel (capture, one tick after the board's own `up`), on window blur and when a text field takes the focus; `selectstart` inside a field (`isTextField`) is never cancelled. `board.css`: fields (`input, textarea, select, contenteditable, .sb-editor`) keep `user-select: text` under `html.sb-drawing` and on the stage. Drawing still blocks page selection during the stroke (checked in Chromium).
- Dev tool: `crm-v2/src/test/sheetLab/liveRoomLab.jsx` + `main.jsx` — `/sheet-lab.html?set=sample&live=1&focus=b6` mounts the real student LiveRoom with in-memory services (saved drafts echo back like Firestore); dev only.
- Tests: `board.test.jsx` (block ends on a release outside the drawing layer, on window blur, on a field's focus, on unmount; a field's `selectstart` is not cancelled — 3 of them fail on the old code); new `live-classroom/LiveRoom.typing.test.jsx` (student room, default tool, spotlit writing field, gaps, open answer (translation), õ ä ö ü bar, all 4 answer fonts, press released over the dock — the last fails on the old code).
- Checks: `cd crm-v2 && npx eslint src --quiet` no output; `npx vitest run src/features/board src/features/live-classroom src/features/worksheet-studio` 126 files / 951 tests passed; `e2e` layout (`npx playwright test -c playwright.layout.config.cjs`) 31/31 passed; Playwright Chromium probes on `sheet-lab ?live=1` (desktop + iPad emulation) type into the writing field. Not checked in Safari / WebKit (no WebKit build on this Mac) and not with the real lesson.
- Limits: the WebKit mechanism is inferred, not observed; if a student still cannot type after deploy, ask for the browser (Safari / iPad?) and check `document.documentElement.className` in that browser.
- PR: draft (see GitHub, `agent/fix-writing-block-input`). Production: none. Deploy: hosting only, after the owner's OK.
- Next safe step: after the owner's OK deploy hosting and have a student on Safari draw on the board, release the pen over the tool dock, then type into a writing task.

## 2026-11-04 · agent/invoice-payer-snapshot — new invoices store the payer and e-mail they are sent to (one resolution)

- Base: `origin/main` c0054f8 (#1105), checked 2026-11-04. Finance only; no rules, indexes, data migration or change of issued invoices.
- Bug: manual invoice `manual_invoice-…` (Kursued, 270 €) stored studentName / payerName „Jekaterina”, parentEmail / payerEmail / parentEmailLower '' but was e-mailed to the card's parent address. Cause: the payer snapshot is taken from the card at creation (`manual-invoice-core.js` and three other copies of the same logic), while the e-mail (`index.js` `sendInvoiceMessage`) resolves the recipient again from the card at sending time with a different field list plus the linked parent account. When the card was incomplete at creation (first name only, no e-mail; filled in afterwards) or the address lived only on the linked parent account, the invoice kept an empty / short snapshot while the e-mail still went out — so the PDF had no e-mail and the parent's `ownsInvoice` (parentEmailLower) could not match. The card rename (`studentsService.rename`) correctly never touches invoices.
- Fix: new `functions/invoice-payer-core.js` (`firstEmail`, `cardPayerEmail`, `cardPayerName`, `invoicePayerSnapshot`, `invoiceRecipient`): studentName = card `name` (trimmed, full); payerName = payerName → companyName → parentName → guardianName → name (adult self-payer); one e-mail = card payerEmail → parentEmail → billingEmail → contactEmail → guardianEmail → email (valid addresses only), else the linked parent account's login e-mail (read in the creating transaction only when the card has none); stored in payerEmail / parentEmail and both `*Lower`. Used by `manualInvoiceRecord` (manual, monthly, lesson package, combined monthly / manual via `combined-invoice-core.js`), `createLessonInvoice` in `index.js`, and `invoiceRecipient` for sending (snapshot first, then the same card resolution) — store and send cannot differ. `/students` list returns `payerEmail` + `linkedParent`.
- UI: `crm-v2/src/features/finance/invoicePayer.js` (browser mirror, keep field order equal). „Lisa arve” shows „Maksja: … · e-post” under the form and in the preview; with no e-mail and no linked parent account: „Arvel pole saaja e-posti”, first „Loo arve” stops with that warning, a second press creates anyway; a one-word card name gets a hint to fix the card first. `TokenInvoiceDialog` and `monthlyBilling.payerEmailOf` use the same helpers. Display only for old invoices: PDF (`invoice-document.js`) and credit note PDF fall back to `emailRecipient` after payer / parent e-mail; the month list row shows payer e-mail → parent e-mail → emailRecipient.
- Behaviour change for new invoices: a self-paying adult's own e-mail is now also stored as `parentEmail` / `parentEmailLower` (as the owner asked: the same address everywhere); a card with an invalid e-mail string is no longer copied.
- Files: `functions/{invoice-payer-core.js,invoice-payer-core.test.js,manual-invoice-core.js,manual-invoice-api.js,combined-invoice-core.js,index.js,invoice-document.js,credit-note-document.js}`, `crm-v2/src/features/finance/{invoicePayer.js,invoicePayer.test.js,ManualInvoiceDialog.jsx,ManualInvoiceDialog.test.jsx,TokenInvoiceDialog.jsx,monthlyBilling.js,FinanceMonthPage.jsx,manualInvoice.css}`, `ARCHITECTURE.md` (Finance), this file.
- Checks: functions `npm test` 496/496 (9 new: parent vs adult self-payer, missing parentName, billingEmail, invalid value skipped, linked account fallback, issued invoice keeps its recipient, `manualInvoiceRecord` snapshot, `createManualInvoice` reads the parent account only without a card e-mail, PDF `emailRecipient` fallback); emulator (firebase-tools, JDK 21, `--only auth,firestore,functions`, own ports 9199 / 8189 / 5101, demo project) `finance-emulator` + `security-finance-emulator` 52/52; `npx vitest run src/features/finance` 36 files / 242 tests (new `invoicePayer.test.js` 5, `ManualInvoiceDialog` +3: warning + second press, Jekaterina card shows full name + e-mail, linked account no warning); `npx eslint src --quiet` no output. Not checked in a browser with real data.
- Deploy (owner's OK): `firebase deploy --only functions:manualInvoiceApi,functions:invoiceApi,functions:financeApi,functions:sendInvoicePaymentReminders` + hosting. No rules / indexes. The existing Jekaterina invoice stays as it is (its PDF will show the sent-to address after the functions deploy); if the owner wants its snapshot corrected, use „Paranda arvet” (correction) — not done here.
- PR: draft (see GitHub, `agent/invoice-payer-snapshot`). Production: none.
- Next safe step: after deploy, open „Lisa arve”, pick a card without e-mail and check the payer line and the warning (press „Loo arve” once only — the second press creates a real numbered invoice); download the Jekaterina invoice PDF and check it shows the sent-to address.

## 2026-11-04 · agent/word-level-marks — „Analüüs” marks the wrong words, not whole sentences or the whole answer

- Base: `origin/main` 59c8b63 (#1095), checked 2026-11-04. Worksheet-studio marks only (client); no functions, rules, school-Mac tool, fonts (parallel `agent/answer-font`) or stored data changed.
- Owner bug: in a writing answer checked with „Analüüs”, marks 3–6 each covered a whole sentence and mark 2 framed the whole answer field; only „sellisedi” was word-level. Cause: the school Mac (`tools/lesson-transcriber` `learnerText`, TartuNLP GEC) returns one correction per SENTENCE (`said` = sentence with whitespace collapsed, `corrected` = whole corrected sentence); `SheetAnnotations.markCorrection` marked `said` as one span, and when `indexOf(said)` failed (a line break or two spaces in the answer) it fell back to the whole selection = the whole field (box).
- Fix: new `crm-v2/src/features/worksheet-studio/correctionMarks.js` — tokenizes (words + single punctuation tokens with offsets), finds the sentence again token by token (any whitespace), LCS-aligns the learner's and the corrected sentence (case- and diacritic-sensitive) and emits one mark per changed stretch (≤ 3 tokens; longer equal-length runs split per word): substitution → `parandus` = the corrected words; missing comma / word → mark on the word before (first word at sentence start), `parandus` „+ ,” / „+ läbi” and a `selgitus` („Lisa koma sõna „X” järele.”); extra word → „–” „Jäta ära.”; > 60 % of the words changed → one mark on the sentence, `selgitus` „Sõnasta lause ümber.”. When the sentence is not found each change is searched as a whole word; not found → not marked, listed in the pane („Ei leidnud tekstist (märgi käsitsi)”). The whole field is never framed by „Analüüs”. „Minu vead” still gets one sentence pair per correction (unchanged). Stored marks unchanged (no migration); the mark shape is the same (`start/end/selectedText/parandus/selgitus`), so pins/popovers work as before.
- Files: `crm-v2/src/features/worksheet-studio/{correctionMarks.js,correctionMarks.test.js,SheetAnnotations.jsx,TextAnalysisPane.jsx,TextAnalysisPane.test.jsx}`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`.
- Checks: `npx vitest run src/features/worksheet-studio/correctionMarks.test.js src/features/worksheet-studio/TextAnalysisPane.test.jsx` 15/15 passed (new: 11 model tests incl. the owner's essay sentences, whitespace/line breaks, õäöü offsets, insert/delete/punctuation, rewrite, not-found; 1 UI test for the two-spaces case); `npx vitest run src/features/worksheet-studio src/features/homework --maxWorkers=4` 96 files / 658 passed (a first run at full parallelism had 14 timeouts, e.g. `engine.test.jsx` 20 s, under load; the rerun is clean); `npx eslint src --quiet` prints nothing. NOT checked in a real browser (needs sign-in + the school Mac).
- Limits: alignment is only as good as the checker's sentence; a missing comma is shown on the word before it (not as a caret between words); old marks made before this change stay sentence-sized.
- PR: draft (see GitHub). Production: none. Deploy: hosting only (no functions / rules).

## 2026-11-04 · agent/reading-grading-lenient — open reading answers: key words, any case, compounds (owner decision)

- Base: `origin/main` ee0c15d (#1087), checked 2026-11-04. Worksheet engine grading only; no rules, functions, data or content change.
- Owner decision 2026-11-04: an open reading answer checked against a model answer was right only when every ≥ 4-letter word of the model was in it with the same stem („rannavõrkpalli” missed „võrkpall”; b1b2-024 Kasuta 4/18).
- New rule (`engine/readingMatch.js`, used by `blocks/extra.jsx` `reading.score` and so also by the video block): key words of the model = not stop words (ja, et, on, see, ka, ning, kui, aga, sest, mis, oli, olid, … the, a, …), ≥ 4 letters or a number in digits. A key word counts when an answer word is the same, has the same beginning (≥ 5 letters, or ≥ 4 and ≥ 70 % of the shorter word), holds it inside a compound („rannavõrkpalli” ⊃ „võrkpall”), or equals it with õ/ä/ö/ü typed without the marks (whole word or ≥ 5-letter beginning only). Digits = number words (0–10, Estonian + English: kaks = 2), numbers never by stem (2 ≠ 20). Up to 3 key words: all needed; more: ≥ 70 %. Alternatives „a | b” and exact / contains checks unchanged.
- Never stricter than before, with one exception: everything the 2026-10-27 rule accepted is still accepted (`legacySameMeaning` kept as an OR), except when the model has a number in digits and the answer has a different number („kell 8” for „kell 7” is now wrong).
- Stored scores: `engine/storedScore.js` `effectiveScore` now also shows today's result when it finds more right answers on the same items (display only, never lowers, nothing written; `storedScore` keeps the original, the review dialog's „re-checked” note appears). So old assignments show the lenient result without a migration.
- Grading pin: `gradingPin.golden.js` NOT changed — no pinned entry moved. The pin types each key's first answer exactly (and „0”), which both rules accept; the new rule only changes near-miss answers, which the pin does not type. The real case is covered by tests instead.
- Files: `crm-v2/src/features/worksheet-studio/engine/{readingMatch.js,readingMatch.test.js,storedScore.js,blocks/extra.jsx}`, `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`.
- Checks: `npx vitest run src/features/worksheet-studio src/features/worksheet-generator src/features/homework src/features/learner` 174 files passed, 1 skipped (1824 tests passed, 12 skipped); new `readingMatch.test.js` 10 tests (võrkpall / rannavõrkpalli, stop-word-only answer stays wrong, numbers, 70 % / all-of-3, diacritics, old accepted cases, the real archive v3 b1b2-024 Kasuta sheet, old stored score shown higher, never lowered); `gradingPin.test.js` passes unchanged; `npx eslint src --quiet` prints nothing. Not checked in a browser.
- Limits: the stop list and thresholds are judgement; a 4-key answer with one key missing is now right (70 %); õ/o-style folding could rarely join two real words (säär / saar). Other readers of the raw stored `score` that bypass `normalize*` (e.g. learner e-mail function) still see the old number.
- PR: draft (see GitHub). Production: none. Deploy: hosting only, after review.

## 2026-11-04 · agent/client-errors — „Vead”: in-house client error tracking (no paid service)

- Base: `origin/main` ee0c15d (#1087), rebased on 7d4d9eb (#1092), checked 2026-11-04. Error capture across the app + one new collection + admin page and dashboard digest; no finance / calendar / content logic changed (Live Classroom: report calls only, inside existing error handlers).
- Captured: window `error` and `unhandledrejection` (main.jsx), page crashes (`PageErrorBoundary.componentDidCatch`, kind `render`; stale-build chunk errors are not reported, they reload), Firestore writes refused by the rules (kind `permission`, message „Missing or insufficient permissions (update students/{id})” — collection pattern only), Live Classroom: 1:1 call `failed` after the automatic recoveries, group call `failed` after `MAX_RECOVERIES`, start / join / device-switch / group-camera errors (getUserMedia names → kind `media`, else `call`). Not captured: refused reads (getDocs / onSnapshot) unless unhandled; errors before anyone is signed in are queued (≤ 5) and sent once a user / guest is known, else dropped.
- How Firestore writes are caught: `vite.config.js` `resolve.alias` maps `firebase/firestore` to `crm-v2/src/services/firebase/firestoreWithReporting.js` (re-exports `@firebase/firestore`, wraps setDoc / updateDoc / deleteDoc / addDoc / writeBatch().commit / runTransaction; re-throws the same error, so every page keeps its own message; never reports `clientErrors` itself). Applies to tests too (`vi.mock('firebase/firestore')` mocks the wrapper, as before).
- Record `clientErrors/{auto}`: `message` ≤ 500, `kind`, `route` (path only; ids and link tokens → `:id`, e.g. `/tund/:id`, `/students/:id`), `build` (`__APP_BUILD__` = Vercel / git short sha, else build date), `role` + `uid` (no name / e-mail), `browser` („Chrome 130 · macOS”), `frame` (top stack frame without origin / query), `count`, `firstAt`, `lastAt` (server time), `fingerprint` (16 hex FNV of kind + message + frame without column), `status` 'new'. Sanitizing: e-mails → [e-post], numbers with ≥ 6 digits → [nr], long ids / JWTs / `token=…` → [id] / [token] / [peidetud], URLs lose query + hash; a non-Error rejection is recorded only as its type. Throttle (sessionStorage, memory fallback): same fingerprint once per 10 min, ≤ 20 per session; noise ignored (ResizeObserver, „Script error.”, aborted fetches, browser extensions).
- Rules (`firestore.rules` `clientErrors`): create by any `signedIn()` user with exactly the 13 keys, sizes and enums above, `uid == auth.uid`, `status == 'new'`, `lastAt == request.time`, `route` matches `^/[^?#]*$`, fingerprint `^[0-9a-f]{16}$`, count int 1–1000; a lesson-link guest (`liveGuest` claim) only with a valid `liveGuestGrants/{uid}` and only as role `guest` (others cannot claim `guest`); read / delete admin only; update admin only and only `status` ∈ new / ack / fixed.
- Admin: page `/vead` (route ADMIN, link card in Seaded → Tehniline): last 30 days grouped by fingerprint — count, people (distinct uids), roles, last seen, top routes, browsers, build; tabs Uued / Teada / Parandatud / Kõik; „Teada” / „Parandatud” / „Uueks” set the status on every record of the group. Group status: any „Teada” record keeps the group „Teada”; „Parandatud” + a newer record = „Uus” with „Tuli tagasi”. Dashboard (admin): „N uut viga saidil (24 h)” with the 3 latest + „Ava vead” (nothing when none / read fails). No e-mails.
- Files: `crm-v2/src/features/client-errors/{clientErrorReporter.js,clientErrorsModel.js,ClientErrorsPage.jsx,ClientErrorsDigest.jsx,clientErrors.css}` + tests `{clientErrorReporter.test.js,ClientErrorsPage.test.jsx}`, `crm-v2/src/services/firebase/{clientErrors.js,firestoreWithReporting.js,firestoreWithReporting.test.js}`, `crm-v2/vite.config.js`, `crm-v2/src/main.jsx`, `crm-v2/src/app/{AuthContext.jsx,PageErrorBoundary.jsx,PageErrorBoundary.test.jsx,routes.jsx,accessPolicy.js}`, `crm-v2/src/features/settings/SettingsPage.jsx`, `crm-v2/src/features/dashboard/DashboardPage.jsx`, `crm-v2/src/features/live-classroom/{useLiveCall.js,useGroupCall.js,GuestLessonPage.jsx}`, `firestore.rules`, `functions/{client-errors-emulator.integration.js,package.json}`, `ARCHITECTURE.md` (Firestore ownership).
- Checks: `npx eslint src --quiet` prints nothing; `npx vitest run src/features/client-errors src/services/firebase/firestoreWithReporting.test.js src/app/PageErrorBoundary.test.jsx` 34 tests passed (reporter 19: query strings, e-mails, long numbers, tokens, route masking, browser label, frame, fingerprint, throttle 10 min + count, 20 per session, sessionStorage, noise, identity queue + guest, permission pattern, listeners; wrapper 6; page + digest + grouping 8; boundary 1); full `npx vitest run` 510 files: 506 passed, 3 failed only by timeouts at machine load average 30–40 (WorksheetStudioPage, studentWorksheetFlow, LiveRoom board) — the same files pass alone / with a longer timeout; `npx vite build` ok (build id in the bundle). Emulator (firebase-tools, JDK 21, `--only auth,firestore`, own ports 9197 / 8187): `client-errors` 2/2 (+ `live-guest`, `student-followups` 4/4). NOT checked in a real browser (needs an admin sign-in) or against production.
- Limits: anyone signed in can write junk records within the validated shape (no server rate limit; the client throttle binds honest clients only) — the admin can delete; fingerprints split by build when the bundle's line numbers change (the top frame is part of it); refused reads are not reported unless unhandled; only the top stack frame is kept.
- PR: draft (see GitHub). Production: none. Deploy needed (owner's approval): `firebase deploy --only firestore:rules` + hosting. Before the rules are deployed every report is refused quietly (no loop, nothing visible to users).
- Next safe step: deploy rules + hosting; as admin run `Promise.reject(new Error('test vead'))` in the browser console on any page, then open Seaded → Tehniline → „Ava vead”, see the row and mark it „Parandatud”.

- „Kiirküsimus” (teacher button ✦ in the 1:1 and group top bar → drawer): „Küsimus” (question + 2–4 options, one marked right) or „Vali õige vorm” (sentence with a gap ___ + forms); „Võta tahvlilt valitud tekst” (texts selected with „Vali” or text marked with the mouse); time „Ilma ajata / 15 s / 30 s / 1 min / 2 min” = the room's countdown labelled „Kiirküsimus”. New card „Tunni tahvlid” in the student's „Minu areng” and the parent's „Areng”: lessons newest first (date, teacher, pages), a page opens read-only in a dialog (static SVG, no tools). ## 2026-11-04 · agent/worksheet-score-snapshot — worksheet results: old 0/28 scores shown checked again, unmatched answers never wrong

- Base: `main` 76d394d (#1066), checked 2026-11-04. Worksheet engine + homework normalisation only; no rules, functions, data or content change.
- Report: a b1b2-023 Avasta assignment showed 0/28 although the answers were mostly right (keys `023_d_tone`, `023_d_trans`, `023_d_tr`, `023_d_say`). Root cause: the assignment holds the sheet as assigned before module 5 was rewritten (archive v1: those four blocks); the 28 items are exactly that sheet's dialogue 7 + reading 7 + writing 2 + dictation 6 + transformation 6. The score was stored before 2026-10-27 (e05d904), when every task left for the lesson (no answer) counted as wrong; she answered only the open tasks. Scoring already used the assignment's own sheet copy (`worksheetDoc`), not the library — that part needed no change.
- Fix: `engine/storedScore.js` `effectiveScore` — on display only, a submitted sheet's stored score is checked again on its own copy with today's rules and replaced when obviously wrong (counted more items than today's rules, or 0 right while today's check finds right answers); `storedScore` keeps the original. Used in `homework.js` `normalizeWorksheetAssignment` / `normalizeSubmission` (teacher lists, review dialog, reports) and `DocWorksheetPlayer`; the review dialog tells staff when a score was re-checked. `registry.js` `checkDocument`: answers whose block is not on the sheet are counted as `score.unmatched` (field only when > 0), never as wrong; `unmatchedAnswers()`. `blocks/advanced.jsx`: a transformation / error-fix row whose only model answer is a free example with „…” is the teacher's (no automatic ✗). Translation and many-to-many were already unscored.
- Grading pin: `gradingPin.golden.js` a2-005/practice hash moved (row „Minu nimi on… Ma olen pärit…” no longer marked ✗; score and pct unchanged). All other pinned sheets unchanged.
- „Kahe lahenduse võrdlemine” Kasuta 4/18 (g_read 0/8): NOT the same mechanism. 18 = archive v3 sheet (errorfix 10 + reading 8), so the keys matched; reading answers are checked against long model answers (`sameMeaningWords`: every ≥ 4-letter word of „buss, lõuna, võrkpall, grillipidu” must appear; „rannavõrkpalli” misses). Changing reading grading is an owner decision (pinned) — not done here.
- Checks: `npx vitest run src/features/worksheet-studio src/features/homework src/services src/features/students src/features/learner src/features/worksheet-generator src/features/self-study src/features/teachers src/features/pet` 250 files passed, 1 skipped (2252 tests); new `engine/storedScore.test.js` 11 tests (0/28 case on the real archived sheet, renamed keys on the live sheet); `npx eslint src` 0 errors. Not checked in a browser.
- Limits: stored scores in Firestore stay as they were (no migration); other readers of raw `score` that do not go through `normalize*` (e.g. learner email function) still see the old number.
- Production: none. Next safe step: review the draft PR; then the owner decides whether reading questions with long model answers should stop counting as automatic mistakes.

- Cause: `PayInvoicePage`'s default prop `go = (url) => …` was a new function on every render and an effect dependency, so every error → re-render → new `go` → effect ran the request again. With a valid `?k=` the page redirects, which hid it. Fix: the default is a module-level function; a link without `?k=` shows „Makselingis puudub arve kood …” and calls nothing.
- Server (not changed): `startWithCode` sends no ID token (correct for the public link, sign-in state does not matter). `linkpayApi /start` with an empty `k` falls into the signed-in branch (`requireFirebaseUser`) and answers 401 „Firebase ID token required” — technically right, but a missing code could get its own 400 message. Needs the owner's approval; the page no longer reaches it.
- Files: `crm-v2/src/features/payments/PayInvoicePage.jsx`, `payments.test.jsx` (2 new tests: one call after an error with the default redirect; no call without a code — both fail on the old code).
- Checks: `npx vitest run src/features/payments` 8/8 passed; `npx eslint --quiet src` clean. Not re-checked in a browser on the emulators.

## 2026-11-03 · agent/deps-functions-ff74 — functions: firebase-functions 7.4.0, pdfkit 0.20.2 (supersedes Dependabot #985)

- Base: `main` 2f15942, checked 2026-11-03. `functions/package.json` `firebase-functions` ^7.2.5→^7.4.0, `pdfkit` ^0.17.2→^0.20.2; lockfile regenerated with npm (firebase-functions now brings express 5 + cors; used only by its manifest server and the emulator CORS wrapper, not by our handlers).
- Cause of the red `financial-core` on #985: `sheet-builder-emulator.integration.js` — the OAuth preflight answered `Access-Control-Allow-Origin: https://chatgpt.com` instead of `*`. firebase-functions 7.4 wraps v1 `https.onRequest` in the `cors` middleware when the emulator's debug feature `enableCors` is on (or when the function declares `cors`); the middleware answers the preflight itself with the reflected origin, so our handler never ran. Production does not set `enableCors`; there the behaviour was unchanged. Reproduced locally (removing the fix fails the same assertion).
- Fix: `sheetBuilderApi` is declared with `.https.onRequest({ cors: false }, handler)` (new 7.4 signature): the wrapper passes straight through (origin false → next), so the handler's own CORS (`*` for MCP / OAuth, allow-list elsewhere) applies in the emulator and in production. Deploy manifest of all 26 functions (`__endpoint`: memory, timeouts, secrets, schedules) is identical to 7.2.5.
- PDFs (`invoice-document.js`, `credit-note-document.js`, the only pdfkit users): four made-up samples (basic with a credit, monthly, 45-line 5-page invoice, credit note) built with 0.17.2 and 0.20.2: same page count, PDF 1.3, fonts Helvetica / Helvetica-Bold WinAnsi, identical extracted text and positions (0 pt shift), õ ä ö ü š ž (and capitals) present in both, page-1 renderings pixel-identical.
- Checks: `cd functions && npm test` 452/452; emulator suite as in CI (`firebase-tools@15.22.3 emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions`, JDK 21, `test:emulator` + 14 extra files) 178/178.
- Risk: in the emulator every other v1 onRequest function now gets the reflected-origin CORS wrapper, so emulator tests no longer prove their own CORS allow-list (production unaffected).
- Production: **needs a full functions deploy** (owner's approval); nothing deployed.
- Next safe step: review and merge, then the owner deploys all functions and opens one invoice PDF and the ChatGPT connector once.

- Cause: the server (`functions/student-merge.js`) never refused an archived card, but (1) „Võimalikud duplikaadid” (`duplicateCandidates.js`) left every archived card out, so the pair of an archived and an active card of one child never appeared; (2) an archived other card brought its subject tracks over as running tracks and its old teacher's uid into `teacherUids` (the old teacher saw the child again, the card showed a second active track); (3) the merged card's archive state was a silent side effect (an archived kept card was restored without a word in the preview).
- Done: archived cards merge like active ones, all history (lessons, schedule, homework, invoices, payments, packages, notes, parents, accounts) moves as before. The merged card is active when either card was active; the administrator can choose „Aktiivne / Arhiveeritud” in the preview when an archived card is involved (`keepActive` true / false on `/students/merge-cards`; left out = the default). The tracks of an archived other card come over as „Lõpetanud” (`active: false, status: 'ended'`) when the result is active; a track the kept card also has stays as the kept card has it. Preview: `activeAfter` + conflicts `archived_source` / `archived_keep` / `archived_result`; archived marks in the candidate list and on „Kumb kaart jääb alles?”. Apply: `active`, `restoredAt` / `archivedAt` on the kept card only when the state changes; the audit entry `activityLog/student-card-merge-<sourceId>` records `activeBefore {keep, source}` and `activeAfter`. „Võimalikud duplikaadid” pairs an archived card with an active one (the active card first, so „Liida” keeps it by default; „Arhiveeritud” badge); two archived cards are not proposed. Nothing is deleted; finance amounts / numbers untouched; the tombstone keeps its own `archivedAt`.
- Files: `functions/student-card-merge-core.js` (`resultActive`, `sourceForTracks`, conflicts), `functions/student-merge.js`, `functions/index.js` (passes `keepActive`), `functions/student-card-merge-core.test.js`, `functions/student-merge-emulator.integration.js`; `crm-v2/src/features/students/{MergeCardsModal.jsx,MergeCardsModal.test.jsx,duplicateCandidates.js,duplicateCandidates.test.js,DuplicateCandidatesModal.jsx}`, `crm-v2/src/services/firebase/{accountApprovals.js,accountApprovals.test.js}`; this file.
- Checks: `cd crm-v2 && npx vitest run src/features/students src/services/firebase` 60 files, 333 tests passed; `cd functions && npm test` 435 passed; Firestore emulator (Java 21) `student-merge-emulator.integration.js` 6/6 passed (3 new archived cases); eslint clean on changed crm-v2 files; `node --check` on changed functions files.
- Limits: the kept card's own legacy top-level `teacher` / `teacherUid` and its own tracks are not changed (keeping an archived card and merging an active one in restores the kept card with its old tracks; the administrator ends them in „Õppesuunad” — the preview recommends nothing automatic). The duplicate badge count on „Õpilased” may grow because archived cards are now compared. `student-merge-emulator.integration.js` is still not in `npm run test:emulator`.
- Production: none. **Functions deploy needed** (owner's approval) for the server part; until then the „Aktiivne / Arhiveeritud” choice is hidden (it appears only when the preview carries `activeAfter`), the archived pair already shows in „Võimalikud duplikaadid”, and the old server merges it the old way (restores an archived kept card when the other is active, keeps the archived card's tracks running).
- Next safe step: owner reviews and merges, then deploys the functions and hosting through the usual flow.

- Base: `main` 98ec278, checked 2026-11-03. Question from the content agent: B1 exam sheets show 33 / 30 / 20 / 20 points while Harno says 25 per part.
- Finding: 33 / 30 / 20 / 20 are Harno's own B1 raw points. Harno weighs each of them to 25 („… toorpunkti, mis kaalutakse lõpptulemuses 25 punktiks”), so the sheets were not wrong.
- What the sheets lacked:
  - how the real exam weighs each part;
  - Harno's pass rule (≥ 60 % in total and no part at 0). The sheets showed only the course target, 80 %.
- Verified table (A2 / B1 / B2 / C1): `docs/HARNO_LEVEL_REQUIREMENTS.md` § „Verified exam table”, with sources.
- Done:
  - `harnoScales.js`: `HARNO_EXAMS` (minutes, raw and weighted points, tasks per level), `HARNO_PASS`, `COURSE_EXAM`, `examPartDefaults`, `harnoWeighted`, `harnoResult`.
    - `EXAM_PART_DEFAULTS` is derived from B1.
    - The B1 speaking default is 2 tasks, as at Harno (intro + 2), instead of 3.
  - `harno.jsx` `exampart`:
    - With `data.exam` the header adds the Harno line (weighting + pass rule).
    - The editor can choose the level.
  - `B.examPart`: `exam` option.
  - `courseSheet.js`: stamps `exam` on every exam-part header by course (a2 → A2, b1 → B1, b2 → B2, c1 → C1). Block ids are unchanged.
  - `methodGaps.js` `EXAM_FORMATS`: 13 verified task formats added. The courses already train all of them.
- Checks:
  - `npx vitest run src/features/worksheet-generator src/features/worksheet-studio`: 134 files passed, 1 skipped. Tests: 1532 passed, 9 skipped.
  - eslint is clean on the changed files.
  - No baseline regenerated.
- Limits:
  - Harno publishes no raw scale for B2 writing / speaking, no A2 conversion and no per-criterion split. These gaps are marked in the doc.
  - Published sheets get the new line only on republish.
- Follow-ups (module files, not edited here; other agents are editing them):
  - A2 mock reading has 29 points, while Harno has 30 (T2 = 6 items).
  - B1 module speaking headers say `tasks: 3`, while Harno has 2 + intro.
  - The C1 mock listening part 2 has 6 gaps + 4 choices, while Harno has 10 three-option items.
  - The B1 course's A2-form checks could set `exam: 'A2'`.
  - On the sheets the part order is R / L | W / S, while Harno's order is W → L → R → S.
- Next safe step: review and merge the PR. Then republish the exam lessons through the existing flow.

- Checked live (#993, 2026-11-02): a request sending X-Forwarded-For „198.51.100.7” arrived as „198.51.100.7, <real address>”; `req.ip` was the forged first value. So the last value is the client. The temporary log from #993 is removed here.

## 2026-11-02 · agent/calendar-note-follows-move — the administrator's note stays with a lesson moved to another day

- Base: `main` after #990, checked 2026-11-02. Bug from Oleksiy (chat, 2026-11-02): moving a lesson to another day lost its „Admini märkus”.
- Cause: `lessonNotes` ids are `{scheduleId}` (series) or `{scheduleId}_{date}`. A moved one-off keeps its id and changes its date; a series lesson moved alone becomes a new one-off; a series moved from a date on becomes a new series. The notes stayed under the old keys.
- Fix in `notesFor` (`services/firebase/lessonNotes.js`), read side only, no data written: a one-off lesson takes its newest dated note of any date; a moved series lesson takes the note of `movedFromSeriesId`/`movedFromDate` and that series' note (its own note first); a continued series takes the note of `continuesSeriesId`. Notes lost earlier come back on their own. Substitution („Asendab”) uses the same move fields, so it is covered.
- Checks: new `lessonNotes.test.js`; `npx vitest run src/services/firebase/lessonNotes.test.js src/features/calendar` 28 files, 206 passed; eslint clean.
- Next safe step: Oleksiy moves a lesson with a note and confirms the note is there.

## 2026-11-01 · agent/pet-loop — the pet: a short daily loop tied to learning (stacked on agent/student-home)

- Base: `agent/student-home` merged with `main` (see the PR). UI and pure logic: no rules, functions or production access; no deploy, no merge.
- Owner 2026-11-01: the tamagotchi was meant to be a strength and is not. Measured before: 36 of 72 accounts made a pet, all needs and XP passive, the pet only on its own page.
- Loop (`features/pet/petLoop.js` pure, `PetLoop.jsx`): on home's first screen art, one bubble (language being learned + Russian hint), ONE request from the lowest need that can be met here (`petRequest`), one tap plays on the same page (3 cards through `WordPractice`, „Paranda” with his own sentences, word game, or a topic game started directly by `PetGames quick`). The need rises at once, the mood changes, a line of thanks, then `dailySurprise`, a line true about his own data, chosen by date, absent when there is nothing to say. Done today (`pet.playedAt` today, on any device, or 3 words repeated anywhere) means no more asking today. Homework is requested only when nothing else can be done, because it cannot be done in a minute on this page and „Järgmine samm” already points to it.
- Growth: `nextReward` shows the nearest of the cheapest item or the next art stage, with what is left in plain learning („veel 2 õpitud sõna → Nokamüts”); a reached item takes one tap („Pane selga”, spends earned stars). Levels `petLevel`: 10 XP each, so one lesson a week moves one level a week. One-time news through `growthNews` (browser only).
- **Changes in the numbers:** `petProgress` counts the streak's XP from the longest run ever (2 days or more), not the current run, so losing a streak no longer lowers XP, stars or stage. Existing learners with a past run gain up to 30 XP, nobody loses. XP still comes only from real learning. New outputs `bestStreak`, `lastActivity`.
- Warm: `careMood` no longer returns `sad` for a low need (no tears, also on the parent's and teacher's views), no count of days away (`petLife`), a glad welcome after 3 days, gentle wording right after it, streak hidden at 0.
- Companion (`PetCompanion.jsx`, `companionModel.js`): not on `/student`, `/student/lemmik`, `/live-classroom` (and reads nothing there); by itself at most one line a session (`mayAutoSpeak`, sessionStorage), invitation, lesson soon and celebration excepted; on phones it stands in the page flow at the end of the page, so it covers nothing; no dragging on phones; tour once.
- Pet page (`PetCard.jsx`): room, the one request, one line of numbers, tabs „Mängud” and „Riidekapp”. No Russian explanations as tooltips.
- Data: only `users.pet.playedAt` (existing field, now also set after a feeding) and the outfit fields; `firestore.rules` not changed. Browser keys: `ks-pet-growth-<uid>`, `ks-pet-loop-seen-<uid>`, session `ks-pet-spoke-<uid>`.
- Rule change that would help, not made: nothing is required. A stored `pet.seenLevel` would keep the reveal one-time across devices.
- Next safe step: the owner reviews #974, then this PR; hosting only.

## 2026-11-01 · agent/security-ci — Dependabot, security workflow, actions pinned; history scanned for secrets

- Base: `main` ee2eac1, checked 2026-11-01. CI config only; no app code, no deploy, no production access.

    always, fail-open after 8 s, „Jätka praegu ilma” when saving fails). Opens only when a REQUIRED item is missing;
    optional ones are in the same form. Items: Sobivad ajad (PollGrid + quick choices), contact e-mail and phone (an
    adult's own; a child's parent's), parent's name (child), message language et / ru / en, class 1.–12. or birth

    questions; the account e-mail is prefilled for an adult). A parent fills per child in one form and gives their
    own phone and language once. ET + RU labels, checks in the browser and again on the server.

    `staffOperationsApi`): `/missing-data/mine`, `/missing-data/save`, `/missing-data/report` (admin). Writes only
    the missing fields of the caller's own cards (and only while still empty), never other fields or cards (403),
    `studentAvailability` only when empty, parent's `phone` / `preferredLanguage` on their own `users` profile, and an
    audit record `missingDataSubmissions/{id}` (who, when, before → after).
  - **`preferredLanguage` ('et' | 'ru' | 'en')** on the student card and on the parent's user profile — the contract
    agent/learner-emails (#792) already reads (docs/EMAIL_NOTIFICATIONS.md).

    default Sobivad ajad, e-post, keel, klass required; telefon, lapsevanema nimi optional). Õpilased → „Puuduvad
    andmed” (`?puuduvad=1`): per card missing items, kind, teacher, account, „küsitakse sisselogimisel”, filters,
    counts, „Ava kaart”, „Kopeeri /ajad link” for cards without an account, „Uued täitmised” with before → after and
    „Vaadatud”. Bell: „<name> täitis puuduvad andmed” (category Õpilased) until „Vaadatud”.
  - Rules: `missingDataSettings` admin read / validated write; `missingDataSubmissions` admin read, admin may only set
    the review mark, no create / delete from the browser. Students / users rules unchanged (not loosened).

  cards — kind: 53 child, 3 adult, 40 unknown age (own account, no class, no parent data); accounts: 42 student only,

    one credit note (`creditNotes/{requestId}`, `kind: full_credit`, KN number) for the open amount (original −
    earlier lesson-line credits); invoice keeps `amount`/`amountCents`, gets `creditedAmountCents = original`,

    `correctionOf` on the new invoice, `correctedBy` + `correctionStatus: corrected` on the old one; lessons move
    to the new invoice (`previousInvoiceIds`). Audits `invoice.corrected_credit` + `invoice.created_correction`.

## 2026-10-22 · agent/book-speed — the textbook („Õpik töölehtedest”) no longer freezes

- Owner: the book is so big that the site hangs for some teachers when they open it. A level is 200–270 sheets, and
  every sheet is drawn twice (visible pages plus a hidden copy that measures the pages), so the page grew to tens of
  thousands of elements.
- BookPage:
  - a sheet is drawn only when it comes within ~1500 px of the visible part of the canvas (IntersectionObserver);
    until then it is an empty frame of its page height, and once drawn it stays;
  - „PDF / Prindi” first draws all sheets 4 at a time with a progress counter („Valmistan… n/N”). The dialog opens
    when the page counts have been still for a moment, so a sheet that never reports its pages cannot block it;
  - without IntersectionObserver (tests, old browsers) every sheet is drawn as before.
- Measured on a local stand with the whole B1 course (255 sheets): after loading 2 sheets were drawn and the page had
  4,534 elements (before, all 255 sheets ended up drawn). Scrolling draws the sheets that come into view.
- Checks: BookPage tests 3/3, eslint 0 errors.
- Next safe step: merge; then make printing a whole level faster (fewer measuring passes) if teachers print whole
  levels often.

## 2026-10-22 · agent/calendar-room-free — a cancelled lesson frees its room at once

- Oleksiy (#bug #high_priority #calender): „При отмене занятия через Tühista не освобождается кабинет”.
- Cause: the calendar loaded roomBookings once; a save updated them locally, a cancel, move, delete or undo did not, so
  the room looked taken until the page was reloaded (the server trigger had already freed it).

  hidden at once. Files: features/calendar/roomModel.js (+tests), CalendarPage.jsx.

## 2026-10-21 · agent/teacher-query-chunks — teachers' Kodutööd / Ülevaade „no permission”

- Owner: teachers say they have no rights on some tabs (homework, the main screen).
- Checked:
  - the menu roles: users.role „teacher” for every teacher, no custom claims → the menu is complete;
  - the live Firestore rules equal main (ruleset of 2026-10-21 07:21 UTC); compared with 2026-10-20 they only add
    studentAvailability.
- Cause: since the teacher scope (#686, 2026-10-20) homework, worksheetAssignments, exerciseResults and messages are
  read only if `staffCanAccessStudent(studentId)` holds. For a query that is one get() per student card, plus the
  teacher's profile and securityMigrations/teacherUidV1. Firestore allows 10 get() calls a query, and the client asked
  10 cards per IN query → over the limit → the whole query was refused. Admins pass on `isAdmin()` and never saw it.
- Fix:
  - `services/firebase/homework.js` asks 5 cards per query (`RULE_CHECKED_IN`);
  - `messages.js` asks 5 too.
- New emulator test in security-access-emulator.integration.js: a teacher with 10 cards reads all four collections in
  queries of 5. It also logs the status of a 10-card query, to confirm the limit.
- Next safe step: merge; frontend only (Vercel), no rules or functions deploy.

  (`billingDispositionReason`), set through the existing audited `POST /lessons/billing-disposition` (financeApi,
  admin only, financialAudit `lesson.billing_disposition_changed`, refused when the month is closed or the lesson is invoiced).
- Credits: `lessonTakesToken` (functions/lesson-tokens-core.js) returns false for it; `syncLessonTokens` now also reacts
  to this flag, so a credit the lesson already took is restored through the package ledger (`lesson_restoration`);
  undoing („Tühista „kooli kulul””, `billingStatus unset`, reason required) takes it again. `lessonBillingDispositionPatch`
  allows `school_covered` (only that) on a package-consumed lesson.
- Billing: not billable (`lessonIsBillable`), not chargeable in the monthly invoice (`monthlyBilling.isChargeable`),
  correction note counts „N kooli kulul”; Finance disposition dialog has the option too.
- UI: calendar lesson panel (admin, individual lessons) „Kooli kulul (õpilane ei maksa)” → reason → confirm; badge
  „Toimunud · kooli kulul”. Student card history and the parent home show „Tasuta (kooli kulul)”.
- Not yet: group lessons (attendance has no billing record per student); student portal wording beyond the parent home.

    part of speech (et + ru), form (et + ru: cases with the question words, verb forms), level; our list of ~140

    „Väljendid” with government; „Tõlge”. Entry points: the worksheet word card (double click / double tap) →
    „Võta lause lahti” opens the sentence around the word (`sentenceAt`, `sentenceAround` in WordLookup.jsx); and a
